title: VIP Boat Trip to Tiran Island
overview: A luxurious boat trip to Tiran Island, one of the top snorkeling destinations in the Red Sea. Enjoy snorkeling, stunning marine life, and a relaxing day at sea with three different snorkeling stops.

stops.name: Hotel Pickup
stops.description: Pickup from your hotel and transfer to the sea dock.

stops.name: Sailing to Tiran Island
stops.description: Relax and enjoy the scenic boat ride with refreshments.

stops.name: First Snorkeling Stop
stops.description: Explore vibrant coral reefs and colorful marine life.

stops.name: Second Snorkeling Stop
stops.description: Another fantastic snorkeling location in the Red Sea.

stops.name: Third Snorkeling Stop
stops.description: Enjoy your final snorkeling session at a beautiful reef.

stops.name: Return to Hotel
stops.description: Arrive back at your hotel around 5:00 PM.

scuba_diving.note: Advance booking recommended to avoid higher charges on the boat.

includes: Unlimited Water, Soft Drinks, Tea & Nescafe
Buffet Lunch (Chicken, Beef, Rice, Pasta, Vegetable Salad)
extra_tips: No visa required for this trip.
Private bookings available for families at an extra charge.
Upgrade available to include an intro diving stop for £15 per person per dive.
Advance booking recommended for SCUBA diving to avoid higher prices on the boat.
